summary: The three most noticeable problems are: (1) the skirt and petticoat form a stiff, upward-facing shell around the thighs in sit_chair, jump_tuck, lie_back_elbows and sit_stand, with especially conspicuous leg/cloth overlap in cross_legged; (2) the hands partly disappear into the raised skirt in sit_stand at frames 36 and 54; and (3) deeply bent knees lose their rounded silhouette in kneel_one, deep_lunge and some run samples. Missing cloth physics explains much of the skirt's poor draping, so rigid flare alone is generally rated minor; the conspicuous cross_legged intersections and seated hand occlusion warrant major. No sheet clearly demonstrates tearing, an exploded mesh or a reversed joint. These ratings cover the supplied views and sampled frames; they cannot establish smoothness between samples, ground contact or deformation hidden by clothing.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Skirt front and underside around the seated thighs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat rise as a broad, stiff shell instead of settling over the thighs, an obvious but largely expected limitation of the physics-free chain posing rather than clear evidence of body penetration.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Folded legs and lower skirt opening
items.issue: The hem remains propped open around the folded legs, with green ankle details crowded against the knees and lining, creating small ambiguous overlaps instead of a settled cloth silhouette.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Deeply folded knee in the three-quarter view
items.issue: The folded knee forms a tight, flattened bend with reduced apparent joint volume, although there is no clearly reversed joint or disconnected limb.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Lap, crossed shins and surrounding skirt lining
items.issue: The skirt and lining fold up through the crossed-leg region, visibly interleaving with the shins and shoes instead of surrounding them, so the missing cloth simulation produces conspicuous apparent body/cloth intersections.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Rear bent knee in the three-quarter view
items.issue: The rear knee has a narrow, angular inner bend and a flattened outer contour that slightly reduces the sense of a solid joint.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt hem
items.issue: The skirt lifts as a relatively rigid flap over the raised thigh, with a compressed transition at the leg opening that is noticeable but consistent with the absence of cloth physics.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh and front skirt hem
items.issue: The hem rises as a stiff continuous shelf over the lifted leg rather than forming local folds, without an unmistakable deep body intersection at this scale.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Skirt underside surrounding both tucked thighs
items.issue: The skirt becomes an exaggerated bowl-like shell around the tucked legs, a conspicuous physics-free cloth shape, but the visible knees remain coherent and clear penetration is not established.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised thigh and lifted skirt panel
items.issue: A large skirt section follows the kicking leg as one stiff panel, leaving an abrupt cloth transition around the thigh that would need simulated draping for a natural result.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.issue: The inflated sleeves crowd together and visually merge along the central crossing, making their contact look slightly interpenetrating rather than compressed fabric.

items.name: hands_on_hips
items.location: Both wrists at the sides of the waist
items.issue: Both hands disappear at the sleeve-to-waist contact, making the cuffs appear embedded in the dress instead of showing a readable hand resting on each hip.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeve overlap at the center of the chest
items.issue: The two bulky sleeves appear to merge at their central overlap with little contact compression, although the visible hands and shoulders remain plausible.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Skirt underside around the extended thighs
items.issue: The skirt holds a raised circular shell around the legs instead of falling toward the implied support surface, an expected physics-free draping defect with no clear limb break visible.

items.name: look_over_shoulder
items.location: Trailing hair ends on the left side of the front image
items.issue: Several trailing hair tips form a flattened, sharply kinked horizontal shape that reads as a stiff chain bend rather than a smooth lock of hair.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and front hair
items.issue: The fingers crowd into the crown hair and partly lose their outline at contact, suggesting shallow hand/hair clipping rather than a clearly separated overhead gesture.

items.name: run
items.location: Folded knees, especially in the three-quarter row
items.issue: The tightly folded knees develop narrow, hooked contours with some apparent volume loss, while the sampled poses show no clear tearing or abrupt deformation jump.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Hands and raised skirt over the seated thighs
items.issue: At frames 36 and 54 the hands are largely buried in the raised skirt with only small pale patches visible, then become exposed at 60–61, making the cloth/hand intersection conspicuous even allowing for missing cloth physics.

items.name: idol_dance
items.issue: The lifted-leg poses push the skirt into a stiff forward shelf with a compressed thigh opening, consistent with driven cloth chains, while the adjacent 72–74 samples show no obvious deformation pop.
